title: Delhi to Agra in 59 minutes: PM Modi approves north bullet train corridor
description:
Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw announced on Saturday that Prime Minister Narendra Modi has approved the north corridor of the bullet train project, which is expected to transform the lives of many people.
Vaishnaw emphasised that the concept of the construction work for the bullet train, from pillar to girder, will be made in India.
"The construction is progressing rapidly. It will be fully 'Make in India', built by the youth and welders of India," he said.
Speaking before flagging off the new Vande Bharat Sleeper Express services between Varanasi and New Delhi from here, Vaishnaw said, "The prime minister has approved the north corridor of the bullet train, which will change the lives of many. The vision for the bullet train shared by the prime minister will greatly benefit the youth, the middle-income group, and artisans in small-scale industries. People will remember Prime Minister Modi for the next 100 years for this initiative."
